name: map
statement: M.LinearDisjoint N) {T : Type w} [Semiring T] [Algebra R T] (f : S →ₐ[R] T) (hf : Function.Injective f) : (M.map (f : S →ₗ[R] T)).LinearDisjoint (N.map (f : S →ₗ[R] T))

name: linearIndependent_mul_of_flat_left
statement: M.LinearDisjoint N) [Module.Flat R M] {κ ι : Type*} {m : κ → M} {n : ι → N} (hm : LinearIndependent R m) (hn : LinearIndependent R n) : LinearIndependent R fun (i : κ × ι) ↦ (m i.1).1 * (n i.2).1

name: linearIndependent_mul_of_flat_right
statement: M.LinearDisjoint N) [Module.Flat R N] {κ ι : Type*} {m : κ → M} {n : ι → N} (hm : LinearIndependent R m) (hn : LinearIndependent R n) : LinearIndependent R fun (i : κ × ι) ↦ (m i.1).1 * (n i.2).1

name: of_le_left_of_flat
statement: M.LinearDisjoint N) {M' : Submodule R S} (h : M' ≤ M) [Module.Flat R N] : M'.LinearDisjoint N

name: of_le_right_of_flat
statement: M.LinearDisjoint N) {N' : Submodule R S} (h : N' ≤ N) [Module.Flat R M] : M.LinearDisjoint N'

name: rank_inf_le_one_of_commute_of_flat
statement: Module.Flat R M ∨ Module.Flat R N) (hc : ∀ (m n : ↥(M ⊓ N)), Commute m.1 n.1) : Module.rank R ↥(M ⊓ N) ≤ 1
